deep_explanation: This is a core Hero section module used at the very top of a website or landing page. It is designed to grab the user's attention immediately.
key_features: Headings & Subheadings: Supports dynamic H1-H6 tags for SEO optimization.
Call To Action (CTA): Includes fully customizable primary and secondary buttons.
Media Backgrounds: Allows setting a solid color, gradient, image, or autoplaying video as the background.
Design Settings: Includes responsive spacing (padding/margins), content alignment options, and overlay opacities to ensure text is readable over images.
best_use_case: Ideal for the homepage header or the main welcoming section of a service/product page where a strong initial impact is required.

deep_explanation: A specialized global footer module designed to close out a web page professionally. It organizes essential navigational links without cluttering the UI.
key_features: Single-Step Navigation: Perfect for simple, straightforward footer menus instead of complex mega-menus.
Brand Assets: Dedicated space for the company logo and copyright text.
Social Media Integration: Built-in options to link to Facebook, Twitter, LinkedIn, Instagram, etc., with vector icons.
Legal & Compliance: Features stylized text fields specifically meant for Privacy Policies and Terms of Service links.
best_use_case: Best used globally across the entire website at the bottom of the page to provide users with important secondary links and compliance information.

deep_explanation: A conversion-focused module created to highlight special offers, resources, or lead magnets without interrupting the user's reading flow.
key_features: Clean Typography Layout: Minimalist design focusing purely on the offer text (body text) and a single action point.
Direct Call To Action (CTA): Provides a straightforward button for users to act on the offer (e.g., 'Download Now', 'Learn More').
No Visual Distractions: Unlike other Offer Bars, version 06 removes heavy images or forms in favor of pure, persuasive copy.
Responsive Spacing: Automatically adjusts padding on mobile devices to maintain a sleek appearance.
best_use_case: Ideal for placing in the middle or end of blog posts, or on pricing pages, to convert visitors into downloading guides, templates, e-books, or signing up for a newsletter.
